title: Cabbage Brain Specimen
description: A surreal installation features a large glass sphere containing a child's face merged with a red brain-like core and colorful cabbage leaves, connected by glowing blue circuit-like lines. The sphere rests on a metallic stand with a black base labeled 'SUI-01 - SEED-1821 - LIGAN 2819', illuminated by a dramatic spotlight in a dark exhibition space with faint cabbage patterns in the background.
